description: This repo is PUBLIC and spotship/.github is PRIVATE, so it cannot extend
the org preset -- `github>spotship/.github` does not resolve here. This
file is hand-maintained and must be kept in step with default.json by hand.
pulls in :semanticPrefixFixDepsChoreOthers and types the cargo
`dependencies` depType as `fix`. Listed before it, that wins and PR titles
stay `fix(deps)`. Every entry below is a Renovate built-in, which is why
they resolve in a public repo when the org preset does not.
No baseBranchPatterns: Renovate processes the default branch when the key
is absent, and a name in it that no longer exists is skipped with a log
line and nothing else, so a rename would stop Renovate here with no issue
and no dashboard entry. Set it only for a branch that is not the default,

packageRules.description: Keep spotship/.github reusable workflow uses on main; never hash-pin
All GitHub Actions updates in a single PR
